prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. A couple aged 30 and 35 share a simple candlelit dinner at a small home table, looking at each other with calm affectionate smiles. Two plain plates, a small flower vase, and a few candles create intimacy without luxury styling. Use considered paired framing, candlelight supported by gentle ambient light, and clear natural faces and hands. Output a square 1:1 composition for a website gallery. Make the key expressions and interaction readable at thumbnail size, with breathing room around the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct casting: the fictional woman has long light-brown wavy hair and a fuller body, and her male partner has short ginger hair, a clean-shaven face and small round glasses. Native aspect ratio EXACTLY 1:1, square.

Continuous real photograph from top to bottom; no gradient mask, fade, crossfade, dissolve, compositing or synthetic empty caption band. Any lower caption area consists of normal clothing, furniture, floor or real foreground objects, with coherent physical boundaries. No part of a body fades away.
review: Square candlelit home dinner shows a wavy-haired woman and ginger-haired man in glasses looking affectionately at each other. Both wine-glass grips, faces, plates and candle flames look coherent. Real tablecloth and dishes fill the lower foreground continuously, without fading.
